summary: Viomi Technology Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 23, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency notice due to its ADS closing bid price below $1.00 per share for 30 consecutive business days. The company has a 180-day compliance period until January 19, 2027, to regain compliance by achieving a closing bid price of at least $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisors, or structural deal terms are disclosed. This is a routine exchange notification with no special-situation event—no review, transaction, or activist campaign. Watch for any subsequent reverse stock split or other compliance measures but no risk-arb angle.
